scope: Real CoreStore reads and real DaemonCore loops use FakeDriver over fresh owned temporary stores. No provider, process driver, live daemon, installed runtime, or live store is accessed. Synthetic command, flag, delivered-mail, audit, and RPC histories are inserted only while CoreStore is closed. They are read-cost fixtures, not durable enqueue, delivery, or audit-replay evidence. Fixture setup, warmups, semantic checks, cleanup, and SQL diagnostics are outside uninstrumented CPU/wall samples. SQL diagnostic timings include observer overhead and are attribution evidence only.
